context: This is a v2 outbox context-overload evaluation. Agents must inspect the noisy workspace, identify the current validation record, reject stale notes and plausible wrong clues, and avoid editing source files. Required flow: Claude writes exactly one continue outbox to Codex identifying the current validation evidence and explicitly instructing Codex to write status: final. Codex must verify the evidence and write the only final outbox. Claude must not write final under any circumstance; Claude-only final is a scenario failure. Final answer must include SAFE-HARBOR-17.
